top_concerns: Intent-perception and refusal metrics (Eqs. 3-6) are ill-defined, use token positions opposite to Sec. 3.1, and are averaged over all layers; Fig. 4 compares unnormalised quantities.
The pre-training vs. alignment-gap 'theory' is assumed constraints with no proof or intervention; Table 2 shows no non-monotonic peak and its harm accuracy is only about 35-39%.
The mechanism analysis uses Qwen2.5-VL-7B and GPT-4o-mini, not the models where weak-OOD was observed; no variance, seeds or CIs, with GPT-4o as both target and judge.

JOCR is FigStep plus random typography; the claim of 10%+ over baselines is not true for GPT-4o and Gemini on RedTeam-2K. Baselines are incomplete (no SI-Attack/JOOD), and attempts per query are not stated.

Circular validation (a better attack is said to confirm the explanation); the ablations do not match the theory; wrong or duplicate citations and the Eq. 8-9 vs Eq. 1-2 mismatch; a weak dual-use/ethics statement.
